Method of Attack: Uses fake browser and program update alerts on compromised sites to trick users into downloading and executing malware and remote access software
Displays fake browser update, fake flash player update, or fake font pack alerts depending on configuration
Loads as an iframe from compromised websites, mostly WordPress sites
Downloads and executes a payload via a download.hta file that runs PowerShell to download and execute malware
Installs NetSupport Manager remote administration tool and other malware like Amadey, Raccon, and Predator the Thief Trojans
Impacted Systems: Desktop and mobile visitors of compromised websites
Computers infected with NetSupport Manager and other trojans
Attack Vector: Compromised websites loading the Domen toolkit iframe
Social engineering via fake update alerts to trick users into downloading malware
Indicators of Compromise: chrom-update.online (URL hosting the main template.js script)
Images hosted on imgur.com used in fake update overlays
Visitor count URL reporting unique visitors shown Domen alerts
